title: The Crossing of the Jordan

questions.question: What was to lead the way for the Israelites?
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:3 (ESV): "...When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God being carried by the Levitical priests, then you shall set out..."

questions.question: Who carried the Ark of the Covenant?
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:3 (ESV): "...being carried by the Levitical priests..."

questions.question: What happened when the priests' feet touched the water?
options: The waters were cut off and stood in a heap
questions.correctAnswer: The waters were cut off and stood in a heap
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:13, 16 (ESV): "...the waters coming down from above shall be stopped, and they shall stand in a heap."

questions.question: How far were the people to keep from the Ark?
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:4 (ESV): "Yet there shall be a distance between you and it, about 2,000 cubits in length."

questions.question: Why were they to sanctify themselves?
options: For tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you
questions.correctAnswer: For tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:5 (ESV): "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you."

questions.question: What was the condition of the Jordan river at this time?
options: It was overflowing all its banks (harvest time)
questions.correctAnswer: It was overflowing all its banks (harvest time)
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:15 (ESV): "...(now the Jordan overflows all its banks throughout the time of harvest)..."

questions.question: Where did the waters stop flowing (the location)?
options: At Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan
questions.correctAnswer: At Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:16 (ESV): "...rose up in a heap very far away, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan..."

questions.question: How did the people cross the riverbed?
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:17 (ESV): "...and all Israel was passing over on dry ground..."

questions.question: What was God demonstrating by exalting Joshua on this day?
options: That just as He was with Moses, so He would be with Joshua
questions.correctAnswer: That just as He was with Moses, so He would be with Joshua
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:7 (ESV): "...that they may know that just as I was with Moses, so I will be with you."

questions.question: How many men were selected from the tribes (one from each)?
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:12 (ESV): "Now therefore take twelve men from the tribes of Israel, from each tribe a man."

questions.question: Which sea were the waters flowing toward (that were cut off)?
options: The Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea
questions.correctAnswer: The Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:16 (ESV): "...and those flowing down toward the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off."

questions.question: Where did the priests stand while the people crossed?
options: In the midst of the Jordan
questions.correctAnswer: In the midst of the Jordan
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:17 (ESV): "The priests... stood on dry ground in the midst of the Jordan..."

questions.question: Why were they told not to come near the Ark?
options: That they might know the way, for they had not passed this way before
Because it was holy and dangerous
So they wouldn't crowd the priests
questions.correctAnswer: That they might know the way, for they had not passed this way before
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:4 (ESV): "...that you may know the way you shall go, for you have not passed this way before."

questions.question: God promised to drive out which specific list of nations?
options: The Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites
questions.correctAnswer: The Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:10 (ESV): "...and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, the Hittites..."

questions.question: What is the "Lord of all the earth" title associated with here?
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:11 (ESV): "Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is passing over before you..."

key_verse_text: Then Joshua said to the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.” (ESV)
